subject: MedalTech private deploy — connectivity acceptance & on-prem packaging cadence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@medaltech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedalTech private deploy — connectivity acceptance & on-prem packaging cadence

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our implementation plan, we want to lock the connectivity acceptance criteria and on-prem packaging approach before the installation window. To make the run-through productive, please confirm the items below or flag anything we should change: 

- VPC connectivity model: do you want (A) VPC peering + private endpoints for admin/control plane traffic, or (B) private endpoints only with an egress NAT for model telemetry? We need your network team's preference because it changes required route tables and firewall/NACL changes.
- IP plan: can you share the /24 (or specific IPs) you want reserved for Redwood private endpoints?
- KMS/HSM: confirm whether MedalTech will provide a customer-managed KMS key for per-customer encryption or if Redwood should manage keys for this instance.
- Maintenance windows & blackout dates: provide preferred install window (2–4 hour slot) and any blackout constraints for Oct 12–20.
- On-prem package form factor: we can provide (1) air-gapped container bundle with installer, or (2) pre-configured appliance image. Which is required for your environment?

I've attached a short VPC primer and our draft on-prem package manifest for your review (medaltech_vpc_primer.pdf, onprem_package_manifest.yml). If you can loop in your network lead and SRE contact we'll include them on the run-through invite. Proposed slot: Wed Oct 7, 10:00–11:00 PDT (60 mins).

Next steps I propose from Redwood:
- Dev to prepare preflight runbook (route table entries, SGs, private endpoint test plan).
- Marissa to prepare packaging checklist and rollback plan.
- Monica to own acceptance gate checklist and final sign-off doc.

Would you prefer a technical milemarker call (deep dive on routes, NAT, and MTU) or a joint run-through with your network lead + SRE?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Implementation Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@medaltech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@medaltech.com>, SRE Team <sre@medaltech.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 13:46:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MedalTech private deploy — connectivity acceptance & on-prem packaging cadence

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side:

- Connectivity model: we prefer private endpoints for control plane traffic and will peer for bulk data egress (model telemetry) — so a hybrid approach. That means we'll need peering + endpoint IPs configured.
- IP plan: attaching our current topology (MedalTech_network_topology_v2.pdf). Reserve 10.55.200.0/24 for Redwood endpoints if possible.
- KMS/HSM: MedalTech will provide a customer-managed KMS key (we'll share key ARN and key-owner contact during the run-through).
- Maintenance: our preferred install window is Oct 14, 01:00–04:00 UTC (overnight local); blackout: Oct 18–19 (major release).
- On-prem package: air-gapped container bundle is required for our air-gapped clusters. Appliance image not permitted.

Carlos is our network lead and will take the peering coordination. CC'd above. We're good to do the run-through Wed Oct 7 but can also do Thu Oct 8 if you need more prep time.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Director of IT Infrastructure
MedalTech

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: MedalTech acceptance gate — task split and deadlines

Team —

Per Aisha's reply we've got a hybrid connectivity approach and an explicit requirement for an air-gapped container bundle. Quick internal plan and owners: 

1) Network acceptance checklist (Dev) — populate exact route table entries, endpoint IPs, SG rules, and peering CIDR actions. Due: Oct 9 EOD. Deliverable: runbook snippet for the run-through. Attachment: runbook-preflight-draft.docx (I've added a stub).

2) Packaging & installer (Marissa) — produce the air-gapped bundle, verify installer works offline, include SHA256 manifests and install script. Due: Oct 12 midday. Deliverable: onprem_package_manifest.yml + test matrix.

3) Acceptance & sign-off (Monica) — finalize acceptance criteria document and DocuSign-ready sign-off form for MedalTech. Draft due: Oct 11.

4) KMS onboarding (Jonas) — collect KMS ARN and coordinate test decryption with our key owner. Coordinate with Security for key exchange. Due: Oct 9.

I'll set a short internal sync tomorrow to ensure Dev has everything needed for route tests. Once Dev posts the runbook snippet I'll request Aisha/Carlos confirm the IPs and peering route table entries.

If anyone sees a missing item (air-gapped network proxy, bootstrapping credentials, or audit log endpoints) call it out now.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@medaltech.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@medaltech.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedalTech private deploy — connectivity acceptance & on-prem packaging cadence

Aisha / Carlos —

Thanks for confirming the hybrid approach and the 10.55.200.0/24 reserve. We've sketched the initial route table entries and a short test plan for the run-through:

- Redwood private endpoints (control): 10.55.200.10 - 10.55.200.50 (assign during staging)
- Peering route: MedalTech VPC (10.40.0.0/16) <-> Redwood peered VPC (10.200.0.0/16) with no transitive routing.
- Egress test: simulate model telemetry 1GB file transfer via peering — observed MTU 9001 required; ensure jumbo frames on your side.
- Firewall/SG: open TCP 443 inbound to 10.55.200.10/32 for control plane, outbound to Redwood telemetry endpoints on 10.200.0.0/24.

Attached is a short runbook snippet and a link to the acceptance checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=medaltech-onprem-runbook-draft. We'll use Wed Oct 7 10:00 PDT for the joint run-through (Jonas: please confirm and I'll send the invite).

Attachments: runbook-preflight-draft.docx (stub), onprem_package_manifest.yml

Regards,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer — Deployments
Redwood Inference
